about: Hand-curated venue research for the Jerusalem Comedy Festival, keyed by the festival site's own venue key. Not edition-specific: a room outlives a programme. Every figure carries the URL it was read from; a figure nobody could cite is null, never estimated.

בית-הקפה-נוקטורנו-ירושלים.notes: Bar/café stage; no published seat count found.

בית-מזיא-ירושלים.notes: Theatre; venue listings seen (funinjerusalem.com) give address and hours but no seat count.

בסרביה-בר.notes: Bar; no published seat count found.

היכל-התרבות-בית-העם-ירושלים.notes: The building has more than one hall and the festival site does not say which one a performance uses, so the building's capacity stays null and no performance is assigned a room.

סטודיו-למשחק-ניסן-נתיב-ירושלים.notes: Acting-school studio at the Menora 3 arts campus; no published seat count found.

קולנוע-סם-שפיגל.notes: The Sam Spiegel film school's cinema at the Menora 3 arts campus; no published seat count found.
